name: Tiled Fitting with Hann Tapering
aliases: Overlapping Tile Partitioning with Hann Tapering
definition: Partitioning volumes exceeding GPU memory into overlapping tiles on a regular grid, fitted independently.
summary: Tiled Fitting with Hann Tapering partitions large 3D volumes into overlapping tiles to fit Gaussian splat models independently, using raised-cosine tapering to ensure seamless blending and prevent visible seams.
